notes.title: Streaming & Content Guidelines
notes.content:
Introduction
Thank you for your interest in VIractal: World of Viractalia!
We are delighted to see players enjoy the game through livestreams and video content, and to share those experiences with others.

These guidelines summarize the rules to help you create content with peace of mind. No prior application or permission is required—please feel free to make use of them!


[hr][/hr]

Scope of Streaming & Posting
You may stream or post content covering the overall gameplay of VIractal: World of Viractalia, including:

Cutscenes and story events

Special effects and cinematic moments

Boss battles

Online multiplayer sessions

Note: For future updates or additional content with significant story elements, we may ask for temporary restrictions. If so, we will make an official announcement.


Monetization
Monetization is allowed on the following platforms:

YouTube (Partner Program)

Twitch (Affiliate / Partner)

Niconico (Creator Incentive Program)

Other similar services in line with the above


Credit Attribution (Optional but Recommended)
#VIractal 

© 2025 STING Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909580/VIractal/


Recommended Hashtags
#VIractal


Prohibited Uses
Please refrain from the following:

Uploading or using only in-game BGM (soundtrack)

Posting cinematic scenes on their own without gameplay context

Using illegally obtained or modified game data

Posting defamatory, offensive, or otherwise inappropriate content

Combining game content with third-party materials that infringe on others’ rights


About Spoilers
If your content includes important story events or dramatic scenes, we kindly ask you to add a “Spoiler Warning” in the video title or description.


For Corporations & Media
If you represent a company, media outlet, or corporate-affiliated streamer and wish to broadcast this game, please contact us through:


https://www.sting.co.jp/contact/


Updates to the Guidelines
These guidelines may be updated or modified without prior notice, especially in line with future updates to the game. Please check our official X (Twitter) account and website for the latest information.


A Small Request
VIractal: World of Viractalia is a cooperative game, but you may occasionally experience a bit of playful mischief between players.
Once the adventure ends, it’s reset time—please don’t carry negative feelings outside the game, and keep enjoying the experience with a positive spirit!


Closing
Your livestreams and videos truly encourage us as developers.
We hope you continue to enjoy VIractal: World of Viractalia and help share its charm with even more people around the world.





Effective Date: September 22, 2025
